src.label: Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) — importation of dogs and cats (SPSIC)

head: Every dog and cat needs an approved import clearance (SPSIC) before it arrives.
lines: BAI says each dog or cat needs a valid Sanitary and Phytosanitary Import Clearance, applied for online through the DA trade system; processing takes about 11 working days. An importer may bring at most 3 animals a year, or the same 3 more than once if the microchip numbers match.

The animal must be at least 4 months old when the application is made, and pregnant animals are not accepted. Rabies vaccination must come from a licensed vet, and even a booster must be at least 14 days old when you apply. Three-year rabies vaccines from the source country are accepted.
A rabies antibody test is not required now, but BAI announces new documentary and health requirements from 1 January 2027 that include one for every application.
